facts.text: The README's primary command launches so101_gazebo.launch.py with moveit:=follower.
The README runs object_detector.py against the Gazebo graph with use_sim_time:=true.
The README bridges /d435i/image as sensor_msgs/msg/Image from a Gazebo Image message.
object_detector.py imports JointTrajectory and JointTrajectoryPoint from trajectory_msgs.msg.
object_detector.py creates a publisher on the absolute /arm_controller/joint_trajectory topic with queue size 10.
The scanning message names shoulder_pan, shoulder_lift, elbow_flex, wrist_flex, wrist_roll and gripper in that order and sets six positions and a time_from_start.sec of 4.
move_to_scanning_pose publishes the same message ten times with 0.1 s sleeps, then sleeps 5.0 s before setting scanning_complete.
execute_grasp builds nine trajectory points with time_from_start.sec values from 3 through 20 and publishes the message once.
object_detector.py subscribes to /d435i/image as sensor_msgs/Image.

so101_gazebo config/controllers.yaml defines arm_controller as a joint_trajectory_controller/JointTrajectoryController over shoulder_pan, shoulder_lift, elbow_flex, wrist_flex, wrist_roll and gripper.
so101.urdf declares a ros2_control system with the gazebo_ros2_control/GazeboSystem plugin and loads libgazebo_ros2_control with the so101_gazebo config/controllers.yaml.

The MoveIt so101_new_calib.urdf.xacro includes so101.urdf, instantiates its ros2_control macro as GazeboSimSystem and loads libgz_ros2_control-system with so101_moveit_config config/ros2_controllers.yaml.
ros2_controllers.yaml gives arm_controller the five joints shoulder_pan through wrist_roll and a separate gripper_controller the gripper joint.
With moveit:=follower the launch includes the MoveIt rsp and move_group launches with use_sim_time true.
The arm_controller configuration sets open_loop_control true.
The launch resolves robot_controllers to the so101_gazebo config/controllers.yaml path.
The launch starts controller_manager/ros2_control_node with the robot_controllers parameter file.
The launch spawns joint_state_broadcaster, arm_controller and gripper_controller with the robot_controllers parameter file.
The URDF names the model so101_new_calib.
The URDF gives shoulder_pan a revolute range of -1.91986..1.91986 rad.
The URDF gives shoulder_lift a revolute range of -1.74533..1.74533 rad.
The URDF gives elbow_flex a revolute range of -1.69..1.69 rad.
The URDF gives wrist_flex a revolute range of -1.65806..1.65806 rad.
The URDF gives wrist_roll a revolute range of -2.74385..2.84121 rad.
The URDF gives gripper a revolute range of -0.174533..1.74533 rad.
so101_gazebo_bridge.py publishes to /arm_controller/joint_trajectory and /gripper_controller/joint_trajectory with JointTrajectory messages.
The teleop bridge names five arm joints and one gripper joint separately.
process_command fills a missing arm joint with 0.0, publishes the arm only when at least one arm key was present, and publishes the gripper independently.
So101GazeboBridge.stop only clears its running flag and closes the UDP socket; it has no controller or trajectory stop call.

MoveIt's simple controller configuration names arm_controller and gripper_controller with type FollowJointTrajectory and action_ns follow_joint_trajectory, but writes no resolved ROS action endpoint or type.
pick_place_test.py builds a MoveGroup goal in send_goal but never calls an asynchronous send method, and run_test only calls send_goal.
The so101_gazebo package manifest declares Apache-2.0.
The so101_moveit_config package manifest declares BSD.

determinism.notes: Event-driven recording stand-in with no physics step, controller interpolation, trajectory execution or wall-clock pacing; the placeholder published messages do not establish motion or state-hash replay

gaps: the fake records the declared /arm_controller/joint_trajectory publication and runs no Gazebo, controller manager, MoveIt or ROS graph
a publication is recorded and returned as published=true, confirmed=false; no controller receives it, no arm moves and no trajectory is interpolated
the fake performs no joint interpolation, timing, dynamics, gravity, collision, controller error or feedback behavior
/d435i/image, the object detector, /joint_states, TF, /clock and the MoveIt planning interface are out of scope
no source-backed stop or safe-state action is declared; the software latch does not interrupt an accepted trajectory

model review: the follower path's robot description carries two ros2_control systems and two controller plugins (so101.urdf:515-549 with controllers.yaml; the MoveIt xacro :5-35 with ros2_controllers.yaml, five-joint arm_controller plus gripper_controller), and the launch also starts a standalone ros2_control_node with controllers.yaml and spawns a gripper_controller that file does not define (launch :204-211, :271-282); the six-joint trajectories of object_detector.py and of this package do not match the five-joint arm_controller, and the teleop bridge's five-joint ones do not match the six-joint one

safe_state.description: No source-backed stop, pause, cancellation or safe-state service or action exists in the pinned clone: the runtime's software latch refuses new publications, but it does not interrupt a trajectory the external joint_trajectory_controller has already accepted. This package is blocked rather than claiming a stopped state.
